name: Paper Trail
tagline: Every fake handbag has a tell. We find it before your customer does.
positioning: Authentication software for resale shops that can't afford a $4,000 mistake or a chargeback from a very angry lawyer named Gerald.

hero.h1: Authenticate luxury goods without a forensics degree
hero.sub: Snap the stitching, the hardware, the date code. Paper Trail scores it against 2M real examples and tells you buy, pass, or 'call the owner.' In 40 seconds. Not next Tuesday.

features.title: The 40-second verdict
features.description: Photograph the seams, zipper pulls, and date code. We compare against millions of verified units and hand you a confidence score, not a shrug.

features.title: Receipts, literally
features.description: Every authentication generates a timestamped report with your reasoning attached. When a buyer disputes it six months later, you win the chargeback.

features.title: Serial rot detection
features.description: Counterfeiters recycle real date codes. We flag serials that have appeared on three other bags this quarter before you wire the seller a dime.

features.title: Trained on the fakes too
features.description: Most tools only know what real looks like. We hoard super-fakes so your team spots the $1,900 replica that fooled the last three shops.

features.title: Consignment ledger
features.description: Track who dropped off what, what it authenticated as, and what it sold for. Owner-operators finally know which consignor keeps sneaking in duds.

features.title: Second opinion on tap
features.description: Borderline score? Escalate to a human expert without leaving the record. The verdict lands in the same report your customer will read.

testimonials.quote: I used to gatekeep authentications in my own head and pray. Now my part-timer runs them and I sleep. We caught four super-fakes in month one that I would've bought.
testimonials.name: Danielle Okafor

testimonials.quote: A buyer threatened to sue over a Birkin. I forwarded the Paper Trail report with 62 timestamped comparisons. Never heard from her lawyer again. Worth every seat.
testimonials.name: Marcus Reilly

testimonials.quote: The serial rot alert alone paid for the year. Same date code showed up from three 'different' sellers. Paper Trail flagged it before I met a single one of them.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

pricing.blurb: For the one-person shop who is also the buyer, the seller, and the janitor.
For teams where more than one person touches the merchandise.
For multi-location resellers who move real volume.

homepage.footerBlurb: Paper Trail authenticates luxury resale so owner-operators stop guessing and start proving. Built for people who've been burned by a very convincing fake.
